title: When the Alibi Breaks
author: Gideon Yarrow
blurb: Oscar Ishikawa, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
